scene.title: A review aid for chip samples
scene.takeaway: Research use. A person makes the sample-quality decision.
scene.source: Project method and expert good/bad sample-quality labels.
sentences: This is AI4S Chip Photo Review, a research tool for microscope photos of organ-on-a-chip samples.
It places likely poor-quality samples earlier in a review list.
A person makes the decision.

Small or unfamiliar formats go to manual review without an automatic score.
Accepted images become gray images with a long side of 1,036 pixels.
Frozen DINOv2 features combine a whole-photo view with nine tiles.
A small trained model produces the review score.

scene.title: Reserved photos: a measured ranking increase
scene.takeaway: Same 672 photos. AUC 0.850 vs 0.810. Paired increase 0.040.
scene.source: F03 clean final evaluation; filename-group uncertainty ranges.
sentences: The primary result uses 672 reserved photos scored automatically by both methods.
The ranking score, called AUC, was 0.850 with tiles and 0.810 with the whole photo alone.
The paired increase was 0.040, with a 95 percent range from 0.015 to 0.067.
AUC measures ranking quality. It does not mean 85 percent accuracy.
Review curves do not measure human time savings.

scene.title: Corrections changed the decisions
scene.takeaway: Related filename groups are clues, not verified physical chip identifiers.
scene.source: Corrected A03 and X01 format tests; development data only.
sentences: Scores decreased when related filename groups were also excluded from training.
We withdrew the earlier claim of no loss on unseen cell types.
The tile method still ranked better in the corrected comparison.
Small photos remained a weakness, so they go to manual review.
Extra training and heat-map explanations did not justify stronger claims.

scene.title: Nuclei: separate settings for separate goals
scene.takeaway: 50 reserved nucleus images. Counting and outline results use different settings.
scene.source: F01 nucleus results; these images share plates with development images.
sentences: Separate nucleus studies used fifty reserved images.
B02 reduced average count error from 4.93 to 4.31 nuclei per image.
At different settings, B03 increased the strict outline score from 0.855 to 0.901.
The images share plates with development images, so this is not a new-laboratory test.

scene.title: Stress tests exposed important limits
scene.takeaway: Only about 43% of the smallest tenth of nuclei were found at overlap 0.50.
scene.source: B04/B05 development records. B07 color-image scores are below 0.001.
sentences: Strong artificial noise caused large errors.
Training with noise helped under that noise type, but made clean counting worse.
Only about forty-three percent of the smallest tenth of nuclei were found at the looser overlap level.
Outside color images had strict outline scores below 0.001.
The models also shared mistakes.

scene.title: Separate study: simulated droplet control
scene.takeaway: Simulator only. Worst learned-control episode: 25.3% of steps outside the operating range.
scene.source: Repaired R02 evaluation: 50 new scenarios and five saved training seeds.
sentences: We also compared controllers in a repaired droplet simulator.
On harder conditions, learned control had mean size error of 1.333 micrometers, versus 1.946 and 2.062 for two rule controllers.
One learned-control episode still spent 25.3 percent of steps outside the operating range.
No physical chip was operated.

scene.title: Reproduction checks have a stated scope
scene.takeaway: Rebuilt scorer: scikit-learn 1.9.1. F06 did not pass the additional strict test.
scene.source: F03 clean rebuild, F05 fresh install, and F06 error record.
sentences: A fresh Kaggle setup reproduced the photo pipeline and one nucleus training split.
It did not rebuild every model or supporting study.
The rebuilt scorer completed the ordinary fresh-install demonstration.
The additional strict cloud test failed with no useful diagnostic log.
That failure remains in the report.

scene.title: Measured results and the next validation
scene.takeaway: The contribution is a tested review method with clear limits and human control.
scene.source: Decision ledger and current write-up; future tests are proposals, not results.
sentences: The measured benefit is better review order on the stated dataset.
Human time savings, transfer to another chip laboratory, and physical control remain unproven.
The next steps are independently labeled chip data and a timed study with researchers.
A person stays responsible for sample decisions.
